name: PaylinkOps
description: A minimalist merchant operations console for AI agents and crypto-native teams that creates MoonPay deposit links, tracks incoming payments, reconciles receipts, and prepares treasury sweeps using MoonPay CLI as the real money rail.
problemStatement: Crypto-native operators need a local-first way to create paylinks, observe payment arrival, reconcile receipts, and keep a durable audit trail without building a full accounting stack.
conversationLog:
2026-03-23
- Set the project direction around a narrow MoonPay operator workflow: create paylinks, track payments, reconcile receipts, and prepare sweeps.
- Built the app as a Next.js product with typed models, local storage, API routes, landing page, dashboard views, and a dual demo/real mode split.
- Implemented the real integration path around the local MoonPay CLI for wallet discovery, paylink creation, paylink inspection, transaction inspection, and sanitized receipt capture.
- Kept demo mode first-class so the core product works without external auth, with seeded wallets, paylinks, ledger entries, and receipts.
- Added verification coverage around storage, parsing, commands, routes, and demo-mode end-to-end flow.
- Prepared the local submission package, checked the live Synthesis submission docs and track catalog, and kept final publish blocked pending explicit human confirmation.
